notes.title: Update with New Level & Enemies
notes.content:
[p]🚀 [b]Major Update Now Live![/b]
I’ve released an exciting update for my labyrinth game! Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]🆕 [b]New level added[/b] – expanding the labyrinth experience.[/p][/*][*][p]👾 [b]New enemies[/b] – more challenging and fun encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Visual improvements[/b] – enhancing the atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Bug fixes[/b] – smoother gameplay experience.[/p][/*][*][p]🔊 [b]New sounds and music[/b] – adding more depth to the game world.[/p][/*][*][p]📖 [b]Improved tutorial[/b] – easier to learn mechanics and navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Controller instructions added[/b] – clearer control options.[/p][/*][/list][p]Discover the secrets of the labyrinth and try the new level now on [b]Steam[/b]![/p]

notes.title: July 20 Update Notes
notes.content:
[p]Hello!
The development of my game continues at full speed. Based on your feedback and inspiration from successful industry examples, I strive to deliver a better experience every day. As a solo developer with limited resources, my goal is to push the game forward without compromising on quality or innovation.[/p][p]This update brings three new features that significantly enhance the player experience:[/p][p]🎮 [b]Gamepad Support[/b] – You can now play with a gamepad. Enjoy smoother and more comfortable gameplay.[/p][p]🎙 [b]Voice Narration[/b] – To enhance immersion, voice narration has been added. Experience the story in a deeper and more engaging way.[/p][p]☁️ [b]Steam Cloud Integration[/b] – Your saves are now safely stored in the cloud. Continue where you left off on any device with ease.[/p][p]Thank you for your support. Let’s keep improving together![/p]

☁️ [b]Steam Cloud Integration[/b] – Your saves are now safely stored in the cloud. Continue where you left off on any device with ease.
